card.name: Turning point after a usual-case statement
card.fires_on: Linking words such as but, however, still, and eliminate right after a clause saying what usually or generally happens. The next words introduce an exception or a residual risk.

modes.label: But/however after 'usually'
modes.description: A contrast word follows a clause describing the typical course, and an exception follows.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms are usually intermittent and mild;<< however>>, very rare sequelae include digital ulcer

modes.label: Residual-risk wording
modes.description: A word such as still or eliminate in a sentence saying a precaution does not remove the risk.
modes.example: Even though blood products are now screened for HIV, there is<< still>> some degree of risk because tests cannot detect
